topic: Classifying Animals According to Body Parts and Use
key_concepts: Animals are living things that eat, breathe, move, and grow.
Animals differ in size, body parts, movement, and habitat.
Different body parts allow animals to move in different ways.
Horses use long legs for walking and running fast.
Rabbits and kangaroos use bigger hind legs for jumping.
Snakes and crocodiles crawl to move.
Fish use fins and tails to swim.
Birds use wings and feathers to fly.
Animals use different body parts to get or eat food.
Birds use claws and beaks to get food.
Lions and tigers use paws and sharp teeth to get food.
Body coverings protect animals from enemies and the environment.
